scope: GitHub code and tracked outputs only; no new SSH, API, or official verifier execution

entries.label: UNVERIFIED_LEGACY_EPISODE_LEDGER
entries.finding: Ledger rows lack official Harbor Job/Trial/Verifier artifact; some runs were mock or local host and policy sample counts differ.
entries.required: Trace every episode to official Job ID, dataset task digest, verifier result, actual token usage and paired policy task set.

entries.label: SYNTHETIC_POOL_HEURISTICS
entries.finding: Code branches on pool_id and assigns simulated pass-at-1, oracle pass-at-1 and episode cost constants.
entries.required: Execute equal-K and varying-K on paired official tasks and real callable model pool with verified price and effort.

entries.label: HARDCODED_EXAMPLE_MATRIX
entries.finding: G0..G3 success and USD values directly hardcoded, no official multi-agent trial evidence.
entries.required: Collect real agent/subagent/handoff traces plus official terminal outcomes under the same harness.

entries.label: PREFILLED_CONFIG_NUMBERS
entries.finding: Action/state/supervision comparison percentages come from pre-filled config instead of official trial observations.
entries.required: Per-policy training, legitimate feature ablation and official paired tasks with complete usage.

entries.label: PREFILLED_MANIFEST_HYPOTHESIS
entries.finding: Pre-filled success/cost fields are treated as observations; cutoff 0.72 is in analysis code.
entries.required: Pre-register task labels independent of outcomes and estimate threshold with observed official episodes and uncertainty.

entries.source: No successful official evaluator evidence in current code
entries.label: HARBOR_OFFICIAL_BLOCKED
entries.finding: Docker authorization blocked. Even successful Docker permission branch does not invoke actual official verifier in current source.
entries.required: Official Harbor DatasetID version, task images, real environment, trial ID, unmodified verifier, ATIF trace and reward.

publication_rule: Do not relabel to OFFICIAL_EVALUATED unless raw official verifier artifact and actual task-level Ledger are independently checked; do not infer from filename or passing unit tests.
